docs.summary: A named bucket of main-thread time, such as Physics or Render. See [`FrameStats`](#api~Prowl.Runtime.Diagnostics.FrameStats), which holds the built-in ones and makes new ones with [`GetCategory`](#api~Prowl.Runtime.Diagnostics.FrameStats~GetCategory).
The last part of [`Path`](#api~Prowl.Runtime.Diagnostics.FrameStat~Path), such as "Gizmos".
The full name, parents first and separated by '/', such as "Editor/Gizmos". Unique among categories.
The category this one is grouped under, or null at the top level. Grouping only: a subcategory's time is never counted in its parent's, wherever their scopes open.
The categories grouped under this one, in the order they were made.
Whether viewers such as the editor's Frame Stats panel leave it out until asked for: waiting rather than work, or work most people are not looking at.
Starts charging main-thread time to this category until the returned scope is disposed. Use it with `using`. Does nothing off the main thread.
What this category recorded in a frame. 0 is the most recent frame.
Min, max and average time, and total scopes, over the most recent `frames` frames.
